advice: Abstain. The supplied evidence does not establish that packing a row-major B panel will improve the SME consumer enough to pay for timed packing. The prior panel-packing trials packed A, so their noisy joint scores do not isolate or support a B-panel change. If Sera tests this direction, preserve FP32 values and ABI, include allocation and packing in `gemm` timing, and compare against the unchanged baseline with repeated paired AC controls; check odd tails and the fixed error tolerance.
risks: A packed B layout may add enough copy and allocation cost to erase any consumer benefit. The supplied battery measurements are noisy historical context and cannot verify an AC gain or causal attribution.
